scope: Native installed browsers against an isolated localhost fixture and immutable production bundles. No live Wikipedia edit or production MediaWiki server is involved.

capabilities.boundary: The driver checks immutable release file bytes and hashes. Production-loader download failure and install-index validation are covered by separate release tests.
Classic editor is real DOM. Registered CodeMirror textSelection and source2017 models are explicit fictional component contracts, not a production MediaWiki deployment.

Actual production worker and staged transformations. Preview responses are deliberately fictional read-only API fixtures. Normal, unavailable and constructor-failing MessageChannel paths are distinct native execution cases. Timer fallback may be throttled by the browser and its actual duration is recorded.
Native browser interactions and actual production transaction state.
Actionable unresolved reference finding remains expanded. Removed report groups stay absent.
Actual shortcut clicks the local native wpDiff control; submission is intercepted and never published.
Generated and user-owned summaries are tested separately.
Positive and negative proof branches use an explicitly mocked base revision and rights response. Native policy proof is a separate source contract.
Three independent replacements and exact UTF-8 byte difference. Broader text counting coverage belongs to calculation tests.
Exact text and script-owned field restoration, manual source and metadata preservation.
All data-option controls are inventoried dynamically and changed through native input. Storage alone does not prove transformation semantics.
Separate review action does not change text until explicit correction choice.
One actual action creates PD and project marker, updates the agreed summary, and supports exact undo.
Actual dedicated CSS interface; sanitizer response is a fictional read-only protocol fixture.
Actual control with fictional read-only query results; no external account or Wikipedia mutation.
Article, talk, template, stylesheet, read-only and unsupported model surfaces are exercised locally.
Retired injected section controls are absent while the native section link and unrelated controls are preserved. Inline-editor launching is intentionally not promised.
Manual copy fallback is shown after a deliberately refused clipboard request. No clipboard write or screenshot.
Not a capability of this browser fixture. Bind separately to the immutable release install-index tests before claiming overall release coverage.

proofGatedOptionsBoundary: Preference controls and storage are tested by this fixture. Citation, authority, category, DOI, template and native rendering proof selection must additionally bind the independent calculation and primary-source evidence suites. Toggling a checkbox is not semantic proof.
